topic: MQTT Kinesis Gateway port binding issue
summary_markdown: The chat discusses a recurring failure of the MQTT to Kinesis Gateway service. The logs show repeated crashes due to `CivetException` related to binding to a port (`Possible problem binding to port`). Participants debated whether the issue was caused by a bug in the code (port binding error) or if the external broker they were subscribing to had failed. It was noted that the service ran successfully all day previously, suggesting the fault might not be an initial launch failure.
action_items: Someone will investigate the issue after 21:00.
